The '''suspension tank chamber''' was a [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] facility in [[The Tomb]], an ancient [[Prison/Legends|prison]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. Located in the [[Ancient Rakatan Keep]] region, the chamber was overrun by the [[Esh-kha]] [[Species/Legends|species]] during the [[invasion of Belsavis]], but [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces secured the chamber and encountered the Rakatan artificial intelligence [[Failsafe]], which implored the Republic to prevent the Esh-kha from releasing the [[World Razer]].<ref name="Failsafe" />

==Behind the scenes==
The suspension tank chamber appears as a location on Belsavis in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', and is the site of the Republic mission "Failsafe."<ref name="Failsafe" />
